label: measured
what: Planner ablation: the 8 SKU investigations behind the planner counts (E1, E3 to E7, and E2's SKU as of 10 Oct and 25 Oct, investigated directly rather than through a sweep), plus the synthetic E8, run with the Nemotron planner (planner: model) and with fallbackStep() only (planner: off, CLEARSHELF_PLANNER=off). Same investigate() path as npm run eval: nothing applied or queued. data/ restored from the same snapshot before every arm. Score-only: ids, statuses, rules, counts, tool names and timings; statements are ClearShelf's own drafts; no product text, spans or notice text.
command: cd agent && npm run eval:planner-ablation -- --planner model (then --planner off)
commit: 0d75dd2 (first pair); the second pair ran on 9b0b514, whose agent/src differs from 0d75dd2 only in src/eval/measure/notices.ts
model: nemotron-3-nano:4b (Q4_K_M), local Ollama 0.40.7, planner think on
